20085.long_desc:
The ICT PA7 Bill Acceptor is the first multi-protocol bill acceptor released by International Currency Technologies (ICT). This brand new ICT bill acceptor accepts all US $1, $5, $10, $20, $50 and the new $100 US note. ICT PA7 bill acceptor can be installed in most of the arcade gaming machines and it can also be used on pinball machines to accept all major bank notes. 

The bills can be inserted 4-ways and the lighted bezel makes bill insertion as easy as breath. ICT PA7 bill acceptor can also accepts new currency with a very high acceptance rate up to 96% and beyond. The validation time for this bill acceptor is only 3 seconds including bill stacking. The optic sensors in this bill acceptor can read both sides of the bill which significantly reduce the chance of getting fake bills. The bill path is easily accessible by pressing two buttons. The handy 8-pin RJ-45 connector on the side of the bill validator is designed for downloading programs and updating validation software.

The ICT PA7 bill acceptor is so easy to install and it requires a low maintenance. The ability to work on multiple power sources with simply the change of a harness or dip-switch customizable protocol selection make this bill acceptor a suitable choice for most redemption focused applications, especially gaming machines.

The following bills are excluded.
a. Incomplete bills such as extremely dirty, wetted, broken or wrinkled ones.
b. Bills folded at a corner or side.
c. Incorrect-made bills.

-Bill Insertion: 4 way Acceptance 	
-Bill Width Accepted :62-72mm/2.44-2.83inches
-Interface: Pulse or NISR or ICT Protocol
-Bill box Capacity: 400 bills (350~450)
-Acceptance Speed: Approximately 3 seconds ( including bill stacking )
-High Acceptance rate: 96% or better
-Auto self-adjusting sensor system
-Reprogrammable flash ROM
-Easily accessible dip switches
-Complete with mounting hardware, decals, and power cord
-All standard bezel validators come with mounting kit
